description: A 56-item, five-point Likert self-report questionnaire adapted from the Life Attitude Profile and Positive Coping, Spirituality and Well-Being Scale to measure nursing students’ meaning of life, positive beliefs, and well-being across pre-test, post-test, and four-week follow-up administrations.
title: 56-item questionnaire measuring meaning of life, positive beliefs, and well-being

description: A web-based 56-item Theory of Planned Behavior questionnaire developed by de Jonge et al.
title: 56-item web-based TPB questionnaire measuring supervisors' intention to perform direct observations
